title: Exact GitHub repository lookup
description: GET /api/v1/onboarding/github/repository?full_name=owner%2Frepo looks up one repository on GitHub with the mapped user's own gh, whether or not it is in their catalog. not_found means GitHub answered 404 to this user: the repository does not exist or is not accessible to them, which GitHub does not distinguish. Any other failure is an error reply, not not_found.
